subject: Quarter Quell (The Hunger Games)
title: What is a Quarter Quell? The Hunger Games twist, explained
answer: In Suzanne Collins' Hunger Games books, a Quarter Quell is a special edition of the Hunger Games held every 25 years, with an extra twist meant to remind the districts of the Capitol's power. Sunrise on the Reaping, which opens in theaters Nov. 20, 2026, is set during the Second Quarter Quell, the 50th Games.
body:
There are three Quarter Quells in the series. For the first, the 25th Games, the districts had to choose their own tributes instead of holding the random reaping. For the second, the 50th Games, each district sent double the usual number of tributes, 48 in all, with only one victor. For the third, the 75th Games in "Catching Fire," President Snow ordered that tributes be reaped from past victors, sending Katniss and Peeta back into the arena.

Haymitch Abernathy, Katniss' mentor in the original trilogy, won the 50th Games, the Second Quarter Quell. In "Sunrise on the Reaping," his reaping takes place on his 16th birthday. Scholastic published the novel on March 18, 2025.

Lionsgate's film adaptation, "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping," is directed by Francis Lawrence and stars Joseph Zada as young Haymitch. It opens in U.S. theaters on Nov. 20, 2026. The term is sometimes misspelled "quarter quel" or "quarter quill."
in_the_news: "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping," the film about Haymitch's Second Quarter Quell, opens in theaters on Nov. 20, 2026.

faq.q: How often is a Quarter Quell?
faq.a: Every 25 years: the 25th, 50th and 75th Hunger Games.

faq.q: What was the twist in the 50th Hunger Games?
faq.a: Each district sent twice as many tributes, 48 in total, with one victor.

faq.q: Who won the Second Quarter Quell?
How old is Haymitch in Sunrise on the Reaping?
faq.a: He turns 16 on the day of the reaping.

faq.q: When does Sunrise on the Reaping come out?
faq.a: The movie opens in theaters on Nov. 20, 2026. The book was published March 18, 2025.
